protocol.design: comparative smoke, one sample per case, sequential in integrator-reserved quiet window
protocol.cache: OS caches not cleared or controlled
protocol.order: baseline then after; no randomization or repetition
protocol.core_profiles: 50 standard and 100 thorough are separate campaigns; no cross-profile performance comparison
protocol.timer: time.monotonic_ns around plan subprocess only; scan, manifest/hash checks and fixture creation excluded
protocol.first_useful: complete provisional history status/local counts or complete known fixture HEAD; headings and split prefixes excluded
protocol.terminal: stdout pipe always; stderr pipe or 200-column PTY; --color auto, TERM=xterm-256color, NO_COLOR absent
protocol.terminal_assertions: live ANSI redraw required PTY, absent pipes; stdout plain JSON
protocol.git_cost: exposed collection phase counters only; unmeasured discovery/control processes excluded
protocol.conservation: recursive source bytes/metadata and outside sentinel; atime excluded; generated inventory outside inspected roots
protocol.performance_comparability: strict source/HEAD/target/DAG and judgement oracle; zero normalized item-proof differences; equal shared stashes, relevant discovery coverage, source manifest, profile and applied limits
protocol.normalization: exclude observation clocks, derived digest and judgement fields only; retain source hashes, identities, flags, facts and refusal causes
protocol.partial_failure_capture: other early exceptions may not retain partial streams; rejected standard100 retained raw reports/stderr but after external timing lost before persistence fix
